Inherited from Proto-Slavic *bordàtъ. By surface analysis, борода́ (borodá) + -а́тый (-átyj). Doublet of брада́тый (bradátyj).

Literally, “having eaten (supped) unsalted (i.e. unsalted food)”, from the time when bread and salt were expensive and were given by a host only to honourable/honorable guests.
